limits: Lexical literals within authenticated initialized RAM/SP envelope do not prove computed offsets, access widths, object extents, memory lifetime or physical SRAM capacity.
Native word occurrence is provenance evidence only; no code/data classification or coverage interval promotion.
Known39 root set is inherited, not a complete callback discovery proof.
String bytes agree with native addresses; caller interior offsets and argument contracts still require per-call evidence.
